grain: one row per PERMNO and formation_month

estimation.window: daily observations inside formation month t
estimation.ivol_daily: sqrt(SSE/(n-1)); sample standard deviation of OLS residuals

signal.ivol_decile: monthly equal-count decile; 1=lowest IVOL and 10=highest IVOL
signal.ivol_rank_pct: monthly cross-sectional rank on [0,1]; higher is riskier
signal.tie_rule: IVOL ascending, then PERMNO ascending for deciles
signal.missing_policy: never fill missing IVOL with zero

standalone_portfolio.primary_constituent_weight: equal weight within each IVOL decile
standalone_portfolio.robustness_constituent_weight: CRSP MthCap measured in formation month t
standalone_portfolio.spread: Q1 low IVOL minus Q10 high IVOL
standalone_portfolio.combination_note: final cross-strategy coefficient and final EW/VW rule are not imposed by the IVOL code

outcome.definition: ADJ_PRC(t+1) / ADJ_PRC(t) - 1 using an exact adjacent-calendar-month self join
outcome.missing_policy: exclude from that month's portfolio return; never fill zero

performance.annualized_sharpe_like: sqrt(12) * raw monthly mean / monthly sample standard deviation; this matches the existing project output and is not an excess-return Sharpe unless RF is supplied

combination_interface.interpretation: risk penalty or tie-breaker rather than a high-weight standalone alpha
